nodes.rationale: Integer transition counts merged by addition keep it deterministic; costs a second BAM pass, so needs a regular file; use only for parity or when AS is unusable.

nodes.label: Order-independent fixed-point integer accumulation
nodes.rationale: Integer addition is associative, so eq-class weights, FLD histograms and bias models are independent of thread count and arrival order; chosen over sorting records.

nodes.label: --fldPolicy (baked / derive / prior)
nodes.rationale: Baked FLD replaces the --fldMean/--fldSD prior outright to make requant reproduce the writing run exactly; prior is the only setting for FLD sensitivity analysis.

nodes.rationale: Map once quantify many; quantify piscem RADs with salmon EM; split phases across machines.

nodes.label: --radCompress (lz4 default / zstd / none)

nodes.label: PackedEqClasses CSR structure
nodes.rationale: u64 starts offsets because u32 wrapped past 4G incidences (#1097).

nodes.label: Compressed ShardPlan (incidence-balanced, MAX_SHARDS=128)
nodes.rationale: Shard count derived from data, not -p, so floating-point grouping is thread-count invariant; compressed accumulators replace O(nshards*num_txps) dense clear+reduce. 128 chosen over 256 because the 0.61% gap is below the 2% tie threshold.

nodes.norm_label: bootstrap replicates run sequential em inside par_iter
nodes.rationale: Replicates are the parallel dimension; avoids nested Rayon. Posterior time fell 19.8% at 16 threads with 32 replicates.

nodes.label: Five EM determinism invariants
nodes.rationale: Deterministic class order, data-only shard boundaries, fixed per-shard accumulation order, ascending-shard reduction, data-fixed partitions for any parallel reduction.

nodes.label: InitAlphas / EffLens newtypes
nodes.rationale: Swapping init_alphas and eff_lens once shipped (bootstrap replicates ignored --perNucleotidePrior); distinct newtypes make the swap a compile error, with zero-overhead layout asserted and a compile_fail doctest.

nodes.norm_label: bootstrap replicate optimization (plain em, random start)

nodes.label: Bootstrap replicates
nodes.rationale: Measure how estimates move under resampled eq-class counts; each replicate runs plain EM from a random start.

nodes.label: Gibbs sampling
nodes.rationale: Draws posterior samples; moves along flat likelihood directions that EM from random starts does not; mutually exclusive with bootstrap.
